caption_hook: 🗿 A man working his land in Egypt found 2 giant statues of the pharaoh Ramesses II + 3 more wins you missed 👇
question: Pick one: 🗿 pharaoh, ⚛️ atoms, 🦞 crayfish or 🛺 hero?
share_line: Send this to the friend who loves ancient Egypt
reel_hook: A man found 2 giant pharaoh statues
first_comment: Bonus: the bigger statue's back pillar names the king "Strong Bull, Beloved of Truth", one of Ramesses II's royal names. What would you name your statue? 🗿

stories.stat_label: how tall the bigger statue once stood
stories.headline: A man working his land found 2 giant Ramesses II statues
stories.summary: Khaled el-Shahat found the statues in his village and called in experts. The bigger one once stood about 8.5 m tall; its head alone is 1.6 m and wears the double crown of Egypt.
stories.why: Ramesses II ruled for 66 years, one of the longest reigns in Egypt's history.

stories.stat_label: the year this was first predicted
stories.headline: Physicists found signs of quantum 'strings' predicted in 1931
stories.summary: Hans Bethe worked out on paper that flipped spins in a row of particles can bind and travel together. A team chilled cesium atoms into thousands of tiny lines and saw evidence of it.
stories.why: A nearly 100-year-old calculation is finally showing up in a lab.

stories.stat_label: body length of the record crayfish
stories.headline: A friendly brag led to North America's biggest crayfish
stories.summary: A biologist's giant 'Crawzilla' sparked a nationwide hunt through museum drawers. The winner: a Tennessee bottlebrush crayfish with an 86.6 mm body, about the length of a credit card.
stories.why: A friendly rivalry turned into real science on how big crayfish can grow.

stories.stat_label: he held her head above water
stories.headline: An auto driver held a woman above water in a well for an hour
stories.summary: Pappachan Konoor was delivering a framed photo when a neighbour fell into a 16-foot well. He climbed in and kept her afloat for nearly an hour until firefighters pulled them out.
stories.why: The photo frame wasn't ready a day earlier. Because of that delay, he was there.

fun_fact: Ramesses II is thought to have fathered over 100 children during his long reign.
